subject: Aptiva vendor kickoff / supplier playbook & next steps
messages:
From: Samir Rao <samir@aptiva.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Nina Kaur <nina.kaur@aptiva.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor kickoff: Aptiva onboarding for Q2 integration

Marcus —

Thanks for the quick sync offer. As discussed on the call today, we’re aiming to get Aptiva set up in Redwood by mid-April so engineering can start the sandbox integration. To keep momentum, can you send a concise checklist of procurement items (what you need from us) and a short list of what Redwood will provision once the contract is signed? Our procurement team (cc’d) needs to know the PO flow and expected lead times.

Quick context: we are an early customer integrating with Redwood Hosted API for embeddings and a dedicated route later. Early questions from procurement: tax form, certificate of insurance, PO remit instructions, who signs the SOW, and whether Redwood requires a CLA.

Appreciate a checklist we can share internally.

Thanks —
Samir Rao
Head of Partnerships, Aptiva Systems
samir@aptiva.com
+1 (415) 555-0194

Attachments: none
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Samir Rao <samir@aptiva.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor kickoff: Aptiva onboarding for Q2 integration

Samir —

Great to meet earlier. Below is a compact supplier playbook and the split of responsibilities to get Aptiva vendor-ready in our system. I’ve kept items action-oriented so your procurement and legal teams can triage. I’ll follow up with a shared Drive folder and a DocuSign link for the order form.

What we need from Aptiva (please upload to the shared folder or reply to this thread):
- W-9 (or local tax form) — PDF
- Certificate of Insurance (cyber + GL) with Redwood Inference named as additional insured (PDF)
- Bank remit info + ACH/Wire instructions (scanned page or bank letter)
- Primary invoicing email and purchase order contact
- Signed Supplier Onboarding Questionnaire (I’ve attached a one-page form you can fill)
- If you require contract redlines, send them now (we prefer to preserve timeline)

What Redwood will provide / do:
- Issue PO template and Redwood vendor code (once W-9 and insurance are received)
- Provide sandbox API keys and a temporary rate limit for integration testing
- Share the SOW for signature via DocuSign and provide the primary Redwood signer (Finance lead)
- Set expected timeline: vendor setup (2–3 business days after docs), PO issuance (1–2 business days after vendor code), sandbox keys same day as vendor code

Action items / next steps:
- Samir / procurement: upload W-9 + COI + remit instructions by EOD Monday (Apr 5)
- Laura (procurement): will validate insurance and issue vendor code once documents are in
- Priyom (sales ops): will open the HubSpot deal with PO terms and create the DocuSign envelope

I’m attaching the Redwood PO template and a short supplier questionnaire to speed validation. If anything on your end needs a longer lead time (e.g., vendor legal review), flag it and we’ll add a short contingency.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
+1 (650) 555-0132

Attachments: Redwood_PO_Template.xlsx, Supplier_Onboarding_Questionnaire.docx
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Samir Rao <samir@aptiva.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 03 Apr 2027 10:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor kickoff: Aptiva onboarding for Q2 integration

Hi team —

Following Marcus’s checklist, two procurement-specific clarifications:
1) Insurance minimums — Redwood requires cyber E&O and commercial GL with limits indicated on the questionnaire. If Aptiva’s policy is broker-managed, an ACORD certificate is fine; otherwise we’ll need the insurer letter.
2) Tax form types — for US entities we accept W-9. For international entities we ask for a W-8BEN-E or equivalent; please note this will affect withholding and PO setup.

Process notes:
- Once we receive W-9 + COI and confirm remit details, I’ll create a vendor record and send the vendor code (VND-XXXX).
- PO issuance: Redwood issues POs only after vendor code creation; the finance SLA for issuing an initial PO is 1 business day, provided all docs are in good order.

Please use the HubSpot deal link Marcus listed for invoice terms and payment schedule. If Aptiva needs net-60, flag it now — that will require a separate credit review and takes ~5 business days.

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

Attachment referenced: procurement-checklist-summary (see shared Drive)
From: Samir Rao <samir@aptiva.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Nina Kaur <nina.kaur@aptiva.com>, Aptiva Procurement <procurement@aptiva.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 15:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor kickoff: Aptiva onboarding for Q2 integration

Thanks Marcus and Laura —

Uploading the requested docs now. Please find attached: W-9_Aptiva.pdf and Aptiva-Insurance-Dec2026.pdf. I’ve also attached our bank remit letter. We reviewed the PO template and the questionnaire; Nina will complete the supplier questionnaire and return by tomorrow.

Notes / asks from Aptiva procurement:
- We will request net-30 on the initial PO; is that acceptable?
- Who will be the Redwood signer on the SOW? We need the signatory name to populate DocuSign.

Appreciate the clear timeline — if vendor code can be created once docs are validated, we should be fine for the mid-April sandbox rollout.

Best regards,
Samir Rao
Head of Partnerships, Aptiva Systems

Attachments: W-9_Aptiva.pdf, Aptiva-Insurance-Dec2026.pdf, Aptiva_Bank_Remit.pdf
